title: Fix the code or update DESIGN.md to match, and document the four undocumented API routes
goal: DESIGN.md and the code agree on when a config is republished; every /api route is listed
acceptance: docs/DESIGN.md Protocol section states when the config is republished (on connect, on setup change and every 10 minutes for the grow calendar, or whatever T01 chose) and why; or the code is changed to match the document, with T01's test

docs/DESIGN.md lists GET /api/actuations, /api/faults, /api/feeds and /api/health with their query parameters and response types from packages/contracts/src/api.ts; the other /api routes in apps/hub/src/http.ts are checked against it and any further missing one is added
No behaviour change beyond what T01 chose
privacy: Neutral invented fixtures only; no personal data, credentials or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
If the resend turns out to be needed for recovery in a way the design does not cover, the owner decides the behaviour before the test is written

effort.basis: One paragraph and one route table, plus a check of the remaining routes. Estimated 2026-11-26. Not a measurement.
